services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: There is nothing so romantic as a moonlit beach, except for a Fireworks Cruise on the waters off Destin's Shores. But, our little paradise offers more than white sandy beaches and emerald water. We welcome honeymooners, newlyweds, and couples looking to bring their dreams into reality. Bring along your special someone for a quiet and beautiful sailing cruise under the fireworks, an experience they will never forget. Then, double the fun by bringing some friends and pulling off the best double date ever!
